Thanks — I'd love to help you build this. Before we get into any screens or features, I want to make sure I understand what you're really after, so we build the right thing.

Let me start with the "why":

**When this bookmark app is finished and working well, what would be different for you compared to how you save and find things today?** What's frustrating or missing right now that made you want to build this?

For example — is the pain that bookmarks pile up and you can never find them again? That they're scattered across different browsers or devices? That you save things and forget they exist? Or something else entirely?

Tell me in your own words what you're picturing, and we'll shape the app around that.
